segments.tha-ap453:2.3: Cuto patiṭṭhaṃ vindāmi, jagatiyā idaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.tha-ap453:3.1: “Na me corā vihesanti, nātimaññanti khattiyā [pasahanti, nātimaññati khattiyo (sī. pī.)];
segments.tha-ap453:4.3: Sabbattha pūjito homi, jagatiyā idaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.tha-ap453:7.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi, mama buddhassa santike;
segments.tha-ap453:7.3: Tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap453:9.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā jagatidāyako thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.
